items.title: IUVM: Iran-linked influence content network
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the Iran-origin operation "IUVM", using AI to generate and translate pro-Iran, anti-Israel and anti-US website content.

items.title: Operation "Zero Zeno": Israel-linked influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreprorted Israel-origin operation we dubbed “Zero Zeno,” using AI to generate anti-Hamas, anti-Qatar, pro-Israel, anti-BJP, and pro-Histadrut content.

items.title: Operation "Doppelganger": Russian influence activity targeting Ukraine
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the Russia-origin operation "Doppelganger", using AI to generate anti-Ukraine social media comments, translations, and website copy across several languages.

items.title: Operation "Spamouflage": China-linked influence activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the PRC-origin operation "Spamouflage", using AI to research social media activity, generate posts, and debug a previously unreported website.

items.title: "Bad Grammar": Russian-linked Telegram comment activity
items.summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreprorted Russia-origin operation we dubbed "Bad Grammar", using AI to generate English- and Russian-language Telegram comments on Ukraine, Moldova, Baltic, and US politics.
